campaign: Development regression of controller request-size handling; no scientific or independent model validation
question: Can intake, planning, review and assessment build bounded prompts without silently discarding evidence, prior failures or claim scope?
criterion: Actual canonical serialized provider request is at most 96000 bytes. Preserve original immutable records, scope, units and missing values. Omitted inline documents require explicit count/hash/reference and scoped read access. Fresh design reviews cannot inspect prior AI verdicts. Persist exactly the sent request before invoking a provider.
inputs: Retained IPv6 arithmetic fixture and original source hashes
Exposed synthetic long protocols, histories, feedback and UTF-8/JSON-escaped source text
Read-only diagnosis of a matching production failure where credentials allow
controls: No source-content execution, generated measurements or forced conclusions
No reset of attempts, spend or deadline
exclusions: Database credentials, auth sessions and source text are not written to public reports. Unavailable live state remains a gap, not a synthetic production success.
release: Local correction and checks only. Current user report does not authorize pushing main, deploying, publishing prompts or resuming production tasks. Preserve earlier release profiles and results. A later deployment needs its declared checks and current user authorization.
